name: Verify webhook signatures before processing the payload
content: Compute the expected HMAC over the raw request body and compare it in constant time before the handler acts on any field. A payload that fails the check must be dropped with a 401, never logged in full.

name: Bound every retry loop with a maximum attempt count
content: A retry loop must carry an explicit attempt ceiling and a backoff delay, so a permanently failing upstream cannot hold the caller open indefinitely.

name: Name test cases after the behavior under test
content: A test name should state the condition and the expected outcome, so a failure report is readable without opening the file.

name: Report durations in milliseconds
content: Timing fields are named with their unit and emitted in milliseconds — never bare seconds or microseconds (µs) — so a dashboard can compare two services without a per-field conversion.

name: Keep a migration backward compatible for one release
content: A schema change ships in two steps: add the new shape and write to both, then drop the old shape a release later. The running version must tolerate the previous schema so a rollback does not lose writes.
